status: WIP: independent detached-secondary progress proven through the production RPC transport with a scripted TiKV peer. No workload throughput claim.

files: txnkv/transaction/2pc.go: doActionOnGroupedBatches uses spawnWithStorePool for secondaries after a confirmed primary commit
txnkv/transaction/txn.go: spawnWithStorePool retains the store wait group and submits independent work to store.Go

change.root: The previous process-global FIFO worker called publish_commits synchronously and held the client authority mutex across all response waits. One stalled transaction therefore blocked unrelated detached flushes and every user of that client authority.
change.implementation: Retain one runtime executor and spawn independent suspendable tasks. Clone the non-owning request capability while submitting and retain the original owner Arc through task completion; do not acquire the authority mutex in the background task. Admit every region request before awaiting responses. Add a native task-waker alternative to the existing completion observer slot; poll the original completion state, preserving the callback/run-loop authority. Responses capture existing entry identity without a publication barrier. Shared deadline and per-command secondary failure accounting remain.
change.deletion: Removed DETACHED_FLUSH_QUEUE, detached_flush_sender, DetachedFlushJob and the non-Go OS-thread-count protection test. Replaced the test with a held-response independent-progress witness; backup retains all prior dirty source.
change.limits: This does not complete the Go package or add missing secondary retry/store-lifecycle policies. Foreground APIs retain their existing blocking behavior.

witness.method: Hold transaction A's Commit response after the scripted peer records it. Submit B on a separate client authority through the same detached facility. B must reach the peer before A is released; A's authority mutex must also be available. Release the held response before asserting, including on the old implementation.

before.meaning: B had not arrived when the two-second observation bound expired; this is not an exact old service latency.

witness.interpretation: Proves removal of cross-transaction head-of-line blocking and mutex-held response waiting. The admission timing is a controlled fixture observation, not a sysbench/TPC-C benchmark or general speedup estimate.

validation.results: 20 RPC unit tests and 417 topology-independent tests passed; 11 ignored. Release build passed. Existing transaction completion tests cover response before first poll, response after task registration, cancellation wakeup and release of the task waker.
validation.not_verified: Ready lint, ignored real-cluster tests, full package parity and sysbench/TPC-C throughput/latency. No real PD/TiKV cluster or SQL benchmark service started in this increment; localhost scripted-peer tests ran to terminal completion.

remaining: The prior eight-client read-only regression and control variability remain open. Mixed-write TPC-C performance and general prepared physical-plan reuse remain unverified. The overall goal remains active; no commit or push.
